parameters.help_en:
The notification policy ID.

If you leave this parameter empty, a new notification policy is created.
If you specify this parameter, the specified notification policy is updated

不填代表创建新的通知策略。

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether the alert status is automatically changed to resolved when all events under the alert are recovered. When the alert is recovered, the system sends a notification to the handler.

`true` (default): Sends a notification.
`false`: Does not send a notification
parameters.help_zh:
当告警下面全部事件都恢复时，告警状态是否自动恢复为已解决。当告警恢复时，系统将会发送通知给处理人。

`true`（默认）：发送通知。
`false`：不发送通知
parameters.name: send_recover_message

parameters.help_en:
The event grouping settings.

If you leave this parameter empty (default), all alerts are grouped by `alertname` and sent to the handler.
If you specify grouping fields, alerts with the same field values are sent to the handler in separate messages.

Grouping format:

```
{ 
"groupWait":5,    // The group wait time.
"groupInterval":30,     // The group interval.
"groupingFields":["alertname"]       // The grouping fields.
}
```
parameters.help_zh:
设置事件分组。


不填（默认）：所有告警会按`alertname`分组发送给处理人。
设置分组字段：相同字段的告警内容会分别通过独立信息发送给处理人。
分组格式如下：

```
{ 
"groupWait":5,    //分组等待时间。
"groupInterval":30,     //分组间隔时间。
"groupingFields":["alertname"]       //分组字段。
}
```
parameters.name: group_rule

parameters.help_en:
The notification rule settings. Format:
```
{ 
 "notifyStartTime":"00:00",      // The start time of the notification period.
 "notifyEndTime":"23:59",       // The end time of the notification period.
 "notifyChannels":["dingTalk", "email", "sms", "tts", "webhook"],       // The notification methods. Valid values: dingTalk (DingTalk), email, sms (text message), tts (phone call), and webhook.
 "notifyObjects":[{       // The notification recipients.
 "notifyObjectType":"CONTACT",       // The object type of the notification recipient. Valid values: CONTACT (contact), CONTACT_GROUP (contact group), ARMS_CONTACT (ARMS contact), ARMS_CONTACT_GROUP (ARMS contact group), DING_ROBOT_GROUP (DingTalk/Lark/WeCom IM bot), CONTACT_SCHEDULE (on-call schedule).
 "notifyObjectId":123,       // The ID of the notification recipient.
 "notifyObjectName":"test"       // The name of the notification recipient.
 "notifyChannels": [// The notification methods specified for a contact. Valid values: email, sms (text message), tts (phone call).
                "email",
                "sms",
                "tts"
            ],
 }]
```
parameters.help_zh:
设置通知规则。格式如下：
```
{ 
 "notifyStartTime":"00:00",      //通知时间段开始时间。
 "notifyEndTime":"23:59",       //通知时间段结束时间。
 "notifyChannels":["dingTalk", "email", "sms", "tts", "webhook"],       //通知方式，包括dingTalk(钉钉）、email（邮件）、sms（短信）、tts（电话）和webhook。
 "notifyObjects":[{       //通知对象。
 "notifyObjectType":"CONTACT",       //通知对象类型，包括CONTACT（联系人）、CONTACT_GROUP（联系人组）、ARMS_CONTACT（ARMS联系人）、ARMS_CONTACT_GROUP（ARMS联系人组）、DING_ROBOT_GROUP（钉钉/飞书/企业微信 IM机器人）、CONTACT_SCHEDULE（排班表）。
 "notifyObjectId":123,       //通知对象ID。
 "notifyObjectName":"test"       //通知对象名称。
 "notifyChannels": [//通知对象为联系人时单独指定的联系方式。包括email（邮件）、sms（短信）、tts（电话）
                "email",
                "sms",
                "tts"
            ],
 }]
```

Repeat.description_en:
Specifies whether to send repeated notifications for long-unresolved alerts.

`true` (default): Notifications are sent at the configured repeat notification interval.
`false`: Notifications are sent based on the configured alert escalation policy
Repeat.description_zh:
对于长期未解决的告警是否发送重复通知。

`true`（默认）：按设置的重复通知时间间隔发送通知。
`false`：根据设置升级策略发送通知

RepeatInterval.description_en: The interval for repeated notifications. Unit: seconds
RepeatInterval.description_zh: 重复通知时间间隔，单位为秒

SendRecoverMessage.description_en:
Specifies whether the alert status is automatically changed to resolved when all events under the alert are recovered. When the alert is recovered, the system sends a notification to the handler.

`true` (default): Sends a notification.
`false`: Does not send a notification
SendRecoverMessage.description_zh:
当告警下面全部事件都恢复时，告警状态是否自动恢复为已解决。当告警恢复时，系统将会发送通知给处理人。

`true`（默认）：发送通知。
`false`：不发送通知
